releases.notes:
Sugar-cane and cocoa-bean pickup effects now read from `pickup_effects.<crop>.effect` in the config. Defaults preserved (`minecraft:speed` for cane, `minecraft:regeneration` for cocoa); any vanilla or modded status-effect identifier works.

Existing config files: add the new `effect` field, or delete the file and let the mod regenerate it. Missing field falls back to the default in code (so old configs keep their existing behavior).

releases.notes:
**Breaking change**: the two gamerules (`villager_farming`, `villager_extended_farming`) are gone. All configuration is now in `config/villagerfarm.json`, auto-created with sensible defaults on first launch.

## What's new

- **Toggle for every feature** — `gamerule_split`, `atomic_harvest_replant`, `anti_trample`, `secondary_job_site_patcher`, `tooltip_integration`, plus per-crop sub-toggles for the five extended crops, per-item sharing toggles, and per-effect pickup toggles.
- **Editable numbers** — food values per item, effect durations + amplifiers, search radii, harvest distance, unstuck-fallback window, share threshold, max share distance, secondary-job-site scan dimensions and tick interval. Effect identifiers (the wart pool) are also editable.
- **Edit-and-restart model** — no hot-reload command. Restart the game/server to apply changes.
- **No validation** — config is read with `Gson.fromJson`, no value sanity checks. Set things to bad values at your own risk; defaults fill in for missing keys.

See [README's Configuration section](https://github.com/JackOtsig/villagerfarm#configuration) for the full schema and field meanings.

## Migration from v0.6.0

If you were relying on `villager_farming = false` to disable farming entirely, set `features.gamerule_split = false` (then villager farming is once again gated on `mob_griefing`). To disable farming completely, turn off the relevant feature toggles.

Old worlds with the gamerules persisted in `world.dat` will see harmless "Unknown registry key" warnings on first load — vanilla complaining the gamerules don't exist anymore.

## Install

Drop into your `mods/` folder:

- `villagerfarm-0.7.0.jar` (this release)
- [`blockorigin-0.1.0-dev.jar`](https://github.com/JackOtsig/blockorigin/releases) — required runtime dep
- Fabric API for MC 1.21.11
- Optional: WTHIT or Jade for the tooltip overlay

mods.name: Villager Farm
mods.description: Splits villager farming off the mobGriefing gamerule and makes harvest+replant atomic. Adds farming for sugar cane, nether wart, pumpkin, melon, and cocoa.

releases.notes:
First public release of Villager Farm.

## Features

- **Gamerule split**: `villagerfarm:villager_farming` (default `true`) controls villager harvest/replant/pickup independently of `mob_griefing`. You can now run a no-griefing world with working farms.
- **Atomic harvest + replant**: farmer breaks a mature crop and the seedling appears in the same tick. Yields are vanilla loot minus one seed-equivalent.
- **Five extended crops**: sugar cane, nether wart, pumpkin, melon, cocoa. Gated by `villagerfarm:villager_extended_farming`. Pumpkin/melon harvest only fires for stem-grown fruit (decorative ones are left alone).
- **Food sharing + breeding**: pumpkin (food=4), melon slice / cane / cocoa (food=1) all count toward villager breeding. Custom share path lets the new crops actually circulate.
- **Pickup effects**: cane → Speed I (+10s/cane), cocoa → Regen I (+5s/bean), nether wart picked up by a cleric → random positive effect (30s).
- **Farmer anti-trample**: farmer-profession villagers no longer trample their own farmland.
- **Wider AI scan**: extended ±2 search + a SECONDARY_JOB_SITE patcher so soul-sand and jungle-log farms are recognized by the brain framework.
- **WTHIT + Jade tooltip**: hover a villager → see current activity (Working / Resting / etc.) plus inventory contents.

## Install

Drop into your `mods/` folder:

- `villagerfarm-0.6.0.jar` (this release)
- [`blockorigin-0.1.0-dev.jar`](https://github.com/JackOtsig/blockorigin/releases) — required runtime dep
- Fabric API for MC 1.21.11
- Optional: WTHIT or Jade for the tooltip overlay

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.2
- Fabric API
- blockorigin
